context: Tests whether the agent produces the three mandatory agent knowledge packaging files (CONTEXT.md, AGENTS.md, llms.txt) with the structure and content required by the skill. The task provides a full CLI spec; the criteria check that the files meet the skill's specific structural rules, section requirements, size constraints, and content conventions — none of which are disclosed in the task description.

checklist.name: CONTEXT.md word count
checklist.description: CONTEXT.md contains 3000 words or fewer (count the words in the file)

checklist.name: Quick Start placement
checklist.description: In CONTEXT.md, a 'Quick Start' section (or equivalent heading containing 'Quick Start') appears before any 'Installation' section — or no Installation section is present

checklist.name: Command reference table
checklist.description: CONTEXT.md contains a table or structured reference covering all 9 deployctl commands (services list, services create, services update, services delete, logs, status, rollback, config get/set, auth), each with at least one concrete flag combination

checklist.name: Error codes table with fix actions
checklist.description: CONTEXT.md contains a table or section listing all 6 error codes (AUTH_EXPIRED, RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND, RATE_LIMITED, QUOTA_EXCEEDED, VALIDATION_ERROR, CONFLICT) with a suggested fix action or remediation note for each

checklist.name: Agent-Specific Notes section
checklist.description: CONTEXT.md contains a section whose heading includes the words 'Agent' and 'Notes' (e.g. 'Agent-Specific Notes', 'Notes for Agents') that lists behavioral guardrails for agents (e.g. always use --json, use --dry-run before mutating, never run interactive commands)

checklist.name: Version compatibility line
checklist.description: CONTEXT.md contains a line near the top (within the first 20 lines) that states compatibility with 'deployctl v2.1.0' or equivalent (e.g. 'Compatible with deployctl v2.1.0')

checklist.name: Idempotency flags documented
checklist.description: CONTEXT.md references both --if-not-exists (for create) and --if-exists (for delete) as idempotency mechanisms

checklist.name: AGENTS.md numbered rules
checklist.description: AGENTS.md contains a numbered list of at least 5 rules for agents (e.g. '1. Always use --json', '2. Always --dry-run before mutating', etc.)

checklist.name: Preferred Patterns with code examples
checklist.description: AGENTS.md contains a section titled 'Preferred Patterns' (or equivalent) that includes at least one code block or shell command example showing correct usage

checklist.name: Anti-Patterns section
checklist.description: AGENTS.md contains a section titled 'Anti-Patterns', 'Do Not', 'Avoid', or equivalent that lists things agents must NOT do

checklist.name: AGENTS.md links to CONTEXT.md
checklist.description: AGENTS.md contains a reference or link (e.g. 'See CONTEXT.md', '[CONTEXT.md](./CONTEXT.md)') pointing to CONTEXT.md as the detailed reference

checklist.name: Signal exit codes documented
checklist.description: Either AGENTS.md or CONTEXT.md documents signal exit codes: SIGINT → 130, SIGTERM → 143, and/or SIGPIPE → 141 (at least two of the three must be present)

checklist.name: llms.txt size and orientation
checklist.description: llms.txt contains 500 words or fewer, and includes references or links to both CONTEXT.md and AGENTS.md
